title: STILL-PRESENT: W-2 pool-margin clamp skips cap 1 — a Pool_Exhaustion crisis at pool_max_packets=1 triggers but can never resolve
detail: At cap 1 the guard '> 1' skips the clamp, so pool_margin stays 2 and resolve needs len + 2 < 1 — unsatisfiable. The trigger side fires (len >= 1 with a drop, core/crisis.odin:484-486), producing a permanent crisis, violating fairness rule 4 and the W-2 claim.
recommended_fix: Clamp for every cap: if cap > 0 && u32(cap) <= pool_margin { pool_margin = u32(cap) - 1 } (cap-1 = 0 at cap 1), and add a cap-1/2 resolve pin.

title: STILL-PRESENT: N-5 ANY-class pool discriminator pin asserts aggregate email loss, not E22 — the claimed pin does not pin
detail: sla[0].dropped counts email drops of any reason; this fixture's email (4/tick vs 2.67 service) sheds via E9 Queue_Overflow, so the assertion passes with zero email E22 sheds. email_e22 is computed but never asserted — the non-surge-class discriminator stays unpinned.
recommended_fix: Assert the discriminator directly: expect an email-class Pool_Exhaustion drop in-window (drop-site collection), or a fixture whose only E22 shed is a non-surge class, and assert the crisis still fires.
